test_title: PYST 13: RRB ALP CBT I - Reasoning (Held On: 29 Nov 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) DK-HO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd3ca5543033e646942ca6838b4ec756e61f286efa0de4d903c72d956b213392.png] 

Option 2) RY-VC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/034a7c5553498b94072d9b2fc1729188a57c6b6d683abd92a29782491d825867.png] 

Option 3) QX-UB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15933ff8e67dc611741db432192c054be36aba02447161db2a3b220832338dc4.png] 

Option 4) AD-GJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7221a1964f78e85cb77b84a1122bc4740d3f0c2a47b16e94b8858f71160e4f90.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'AD-GJ' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
